name: Bold Caption Hustle
summary: Giant word-by-word captions slammed onto a tight face cam, with a punch-in, colored money word or sound hit on almost every beat. The captions are the show, so it works even with the sound off.
best_for: Motivation, sales and money educators, fitness and mindset coaches, and direct-response ads. 15-45 second hot takes, hooks and talking heads where raw attention matters more than polish.
why_it_works: One giant word on frame 0 plus a 135% punch-in makes the first second impossible to ignore. Single-word captions are read in under 0.3s each, so sound-off viewers follow everything. A change every 0.8-1.5s (cut, punch, colored word, emoji) leaves no idle frame to swipe on. Whips, highlight bars and shakes every 5-7s act as pattern interrupts, and a promise in seconds 1-3 (watch till the end, a list count) opens the loop.

preview.motion_sample: Giant stroked white words pop in one at a time at chest height, the money word flashes yellow at a bigger size, the frame punches in with a white flash, then a yellow bar wipes across behind a phrase.
